patch_review.finding: Inline page breaks that were no-ops on empty pages became active after typing, but translation retained stale line.pageIndex. Scratch probe reproduced 12 failures in 24 cases; dedicated regression suite reproduced two page failures and two passing column cases.
patch_review.action: Exclude inline page/column breaks from translation candidates. New four-case suite plus existing engine incremental suite passed all 13 cases after correction. Preserve inline-break-before.log and inline-break-after.log; final combined-source qualification remains separate.
